title: RuntimeError
description: schemaVersion 2.0.0. ErrorEnvelope shape (02_26 v1.6 §18.7), superseding the WEB-M0 fixture-stage `code`/`details` shape (aligned to a single ad hoc enum) with the three-domain discriminated envelope approved for WEB-M2 (PLATFORM/CONTENT_RUNTIME/CROSS_RUNTIME — see docs/adr/0003). The client must not infer an outcome from a generic HTTP status when a typed domain error exists.
